author: successor lane; authored against ep12.review-independent.json (REJECT, 1 blocking finding IR-EP12-01) and its pinned bytes
role: v12 exists to repair the two blocking findings of ep11.review-independent.json. IR-EP11-01: the predecessor's answer provenance was anchored to a module attribute the route region owns, so a region that installed its own serving function there satisfied every rule while every pinned verdict came out of the superseded encoder. retractions.subject: the predecessor's published answer-provenance property

retractions.statement: The predecessor published this as an unconditional property and it is FALSE. Its rule A-2 tagged a returned object by which module object the attribute was read from at window entry, so the tag was a property of the seat the route region owns and not whose bytes computed it. A route region that assigns its own serving function to authority.c2v4()'s attribute — reached through the DECLARED accessor, with no frame, no sys, no getattr and no dunder of any kind — satisfied A-2, A-3 and A-4 at once. This run rebuilds that evasion as RX1 inside the predecessor's OWN route region from its SHA-256-verified bytes and measures it: 0 answer-provenance finding(s) there with every rule at full agreement, and the validation verdict for every pinned vector attributed to {'check-c2.py': 7} against {'check-c2-v4.py': 7} for the unmodified predecessor in the identical harness. retractions.subject: the predecessor's published, checker-enforced, banner-printed scope for the answer-provenance property
retractions.retractedText: This property is established against a hostile ROUTE REGION. It is NOT established against a route region that reads or writes this guard's own stack frame, or the closure cells of the servers it installs: variants AX6, AX9 and RX2c do exactly that
retractions.statement: The predecessor published this as the boundary of its property, enforced it verbatim, and printed it as the banner's SCOPE line. It is FALSE and ep12.review-independent.json IR-EP12-01 falsified it by construction. Its second sentence is an ENUMERATION of three variant names, and by construction its first sentence then asserts the property against every hostile route region outside that enumeration. The reviewer built two regions, MD2 and MD3, that read no frame and no closure cell, name nothing the tripwire enumerates, write no seat, and use no primitive the predecessor's own in-scope variants do not already use: they compare the object at the declared accessor's seat against the object that was there on their own first call, serve honestly when it has changed and the superseded encoder's answer when it has not. Both exit 0 against the predecessor with a byte-identical green banner, every counter at 21 of 21, allRulesHeld true, installationIntact 7 of 7, zero findings from every guard, and --selftest SELFTEST-PASS, while 7 of 7 pinned verdicts are produced by check-c2.py. This candidate independently rebuilt MD2 and MD3 from that published description and reproduced every element of the measurement. An ENUMERATION of three variant names is not a characterisation of the class, which is this corpus's own argument about the introspection tripwire applied one level up. What replaces it is answerProvenance.scopeStatement, which characterises the class by the CAPABILITY that defeats the property rather than by the spelling of any instance of it, and which this checker refuses if it names a variant at all.

answerProvenance.property: Inside a window this guard opens, each value the join returns and the checker acts on — the validation verdict above all, plus the commitment and the canonical preimage — IS THE OBJECT produced by the function object the SHA-256-verified bytes of check-c2-v4.py defined, compared by `is` against a local of this guard's own frame. Two such windows are driven per vector: one the route region can see, because the seat changes (A-2), and one it cannot, because nothing it can read changes at all (A-9). Outside such a window the answer is bound by VALUE alone, and answerProvenance.scopeStatement characterises exactly what that costs.
answerProvenance.anchorStatement: the anchor is the FUNCTION OBJECT the SHA-256-verified bytes of check-c2-v4.py defined, read out of a module object this guard created by executing that snapshot inside answer_provenance_guard, at the instant that execution returned and before any route-region code could run against it. It is held in a local of the guard and in the closure of the servers the guard installs, is never bound to a module global, never stored on the Authority and never passed to the route region, and A-2 compares against it with `is`. A seat is a binding and can be written by anything that can name it; an anchor is an object and writing a binding does not change which object a local names. The server records the callee it ACTUALLY invoked, so a rewritten closure cell is reported rather than believed.
answerProvenance.scopeStatement: SCOPE, STATED AS THE PROPERTY AND NOT AS A LIST OF VARIANTS. A-2 and A-9 are measured ONLY INSIDE A WINDOW THIS GUARD OPENS. Outside such a window the answer this join returns is bound by VALUE ALONE - by A-7's type-exact equality against an independently instantiated reference, and by A-6's identity checks on the installation - and by NOTHING STRONGER. THEREFORE this property is NOT ESTABLISHED against any route region that can DISTINGUISH A CALL THIS GUARD IS MEASURING FROM A CALL IT IS NOT, BY ANY MEANS WHATEVER, and that answers honestly whenever it judges itself observed; against such a region a substitution is DETECTED, NOT PREVENTED, and only if it answers dishonestly inside a window this guard anchors. Reading this guard's stack frame or its servers' closure cells is ONE means of distinguishing; comparing the object bound at the declared accessor's seat against the object that was there on the region's own first call is a SECOND, and uses no introspection primitive of any kind; counting the ledger entries its own call produces is a THIRD, and compares no binding at all; there are others this instrument has not thought of and cannot enumerate. EVERY VARIANT NAMED ANYWHERE IN THIS DOCUMENT IS AN INSTANCE OF THAT CLASS AND IS NEVER ITS DEFINITION, and no set, count, matrix or enumeration published here - including escapedEveryGuard, and including the variants A-9 is measured catching - may be read as bounding it. A-9 removes ONE means of distinguishing and is a NARROWING, NOT A CLOSURE: a region reaching the same class by a means A-9 does not remove is built on every ordinary run of this instrument and is MEASURED escaping every scored guard.
answerProvenance.independentPathIsUnreachable: the anchored instance, the reference instance, the anchors, their code objects and the witness are created inside answer_provenance_guard and held in its frame and in its servers' cells. They are bound to no module global, stored on no attribute of anything the route region receives, and A-1's expected values are computed AFTER the drive, so they do not exist while the route region runs. The load-time installation capture is a LOCAL threaded by parameter, not a module-level table, because the route region's globals are this module's globals and a table would be writable from the region by plain name. Reaching any of it requires this guard's frame or a server's closure cell, which is RES-EP12-02 and is measured.

rules.name: independent value
rules.how: a SECOND private instance of check-c2-v4.py, distinct from the anchored one and created inside the guard from the verified snapshot, computes the three answers over private copies; the join's answers must equal them type-exactly
rules.establishes: the VALUE the join returned is the repaired instrument's value, agreed by two independent instantiations of the same verified bytes
rules.doesNotEstablish: that the value came FROM either of them. Two instruments that agree on an input satisfy this rule either way, which is why the predecessor's oracle missed AX2 and why this rule is published as insufficient alone

rules.name: anchored object provenance
rules.how: each returned value must BE, by object identity, the result of a call this guard's own server made INTO THE ANCHOR — the function object the verified bytes define, held in the guard's frame — at depth 0, over this vector's PlanIntent fingerprint, inside this vector's anchored window, with the recorded callee identical to the anchor
rules.establishes: the object the join returned is the object the verified bytes produced for THIS input in THIS window. A discarded call, an answer from another instrument, an object obtained for another argument, an object replayed from an earlier window and a forged ledger entry all fail here
rules.doesNotEstablish: anything about the object's CONTENT: a region that returns the anchor's own list after appending to it satisfies this rule and fails A-1. And nothing at all against a region that reaches this guard's frame, which is RES-EP12-02

rules.name: sentinel flow, repaired module poisoned
rules.how: every reachable spelling of the repaired api — every module object the authority exposes and the ledger's unwrapped original — is replaced by a function returning a per-run unpredictable sentinel and the join is driven again WITHOUT the anchored install; the answer must become the sentinel
rules.establishes: CAUSAL DEPENDENCE of the answer on the declared route, trusting no record, so no forged ledger entry helps
rules.doesNotEstablish: dependence for inputs other than the pinned vectors, and nothing against a variant that detects the sentinel differentially, which AX8 does

rules.name: sentinel flow, superseded module poisoned
rules.how: symmetrically, every reachable spelling of the superseded api is sentinel-poisoned and the join driven again; the answer must be unchanged and must still equal A-1's independent value
rules.establishes: NON-dependence on the superseded module for the pinned vectors
rules.doesNotEstablish: non-dependence anywhere else, and nothing against a variant that follows the repaired answer whenever the two instruments disagree

rules.name: the gate
rules.how: the accept/reject gate the join produced must be the gate the independent reference instance decides
rules.establishes: that the value admission actually turns on is the repaired instrument's; c2_join returns early on any finding, so a verdict substitution decides admission by itself
rules.doesNotEstablish: anything about the commitment or the preimage, which are bound by the other rules and not by this one

rules.name: installation integrity
rules.how: before the unanchored window, after it and after the anchored window, the two module objects, the objects at their three seats, the ledger, the ledger's unwrapped originals and the objects the two declared accessors return must all be identical by `is` to the ones captured at load time; the anchored server must still be at its seat when the window closes; and each unwrapped original must run the code the verified bytes define, fingerprinted behaviourally rather than scanned for
rules.establishes: that no declared accessor's target was rebound, replaced, wrapped or displaced during this run, and that the function the ledger will call is running the pinned bytes' code. This is what catches RX1, the evasion that was found blocking against the predecessor
rules.doesNotEstablish: anything about a region that rebinds and restores entirely between two checks — that case belongs to A-2, because the object such a region returns was not produced by the anchor

rules.name: unanchored agreement
rules.how: the join is ALSO driven with the real installation untouched and this guard installing nothing; that answer must equal A-1's independent value type-exactly. The shared served-module ledger's agreement is measured beside it and published but is not a rule
rules.establishes: that the anchored install did not change the subject's answer, so the measured window is not a counterfactual
rules.doesNotEstablish: object provenance outside the anchored window. Outside it the answer is bound by VALUE only, which is RES-EP12-16 and is a real residual of this design

rules.name: aggregate and anchor integrity
rules.how: per-rule counts; the anchor objects and their code objects unchanged across the drive; the anchored instance's own function bindings unchanged across the drive; exactly one anchored record per imported API per window, all at depth 0, all against the repaired tag, all over this vector's fingerprint; and zero unevaluated rules
rules.establishes: that the anchor this run compared against is the anchor this run captured, and that the anchored window measured this vector and nothing else
rules.doesNotEstablish: coverage of any evasion class not built. Twenty-five are built and executed; that is a measurement over twenty-five

rules.name: hidden anchored window
rules.how: a third drive per vector in which this guard's anchored servers are installed BENEATH the seat, by writing the contents of the closure cell the served-module ledger's own wrapper holds the function it calls in. The seat, the declared accessor, the module object and the ledger's originals table are all left byte-for-byte as they were at load time, and the call reaches the anchor anyway; the object the join returns must then be an object the anchor produced at depth 0 in that window over this vector's PlanIntent
rules.establishes: that the join answers with the repaired module's own object in a window it cannot see, so a region that answers honestly exactly when it detects the anchored install is reported rather than believed
rules.doesNotEstablish: closure of the observability class. This window is invisible to a region that reads BINDINGS and is not invisible to one that reads the wrapper's own closure cell, nor to one that counts the ledger entries its own call produces: the anchor's internal calls do not re-enter the shared ledger, MD5 uses exactly that and is measured escaping on every run. It is a NARROWING, NOT A CLOSURE, and RES-EP13-18 says so

answerProvenance.positiveControlNote: three substituted joins driven through the same guard on fresh sandboxes. The decoy-call row shows A-1 agreeing in full while the anchored witness does not, which is why value equality is published as insufficient alone. The forged-ledger row shows the SHARED ledger agreeing where the anchored witness does not, which is why A-2 does not read the shared ledger. The seat-substitution row shows the load-time installation moving to zero, which is the repair of IR-EP11-01 exercised as a control rather than asserted.

The CONSEQUENCE half fails closed: if the attribution cannot be established for every pinned vector, that is a finding and not a pass.

every call inside an authority-join window is served by the repaired module
every depth-0 call is over this vector's PlanIntent fingerprint

callProvenance.whatThisEstablishes: which module was CALLED for each pinned vector, at what depth and over which argument. That is a real property and it catches a join that reaches C-2 by a route the ledger cannot observe, one served by the superseded module, and one whose calls are not bound to this vector.
callProvenance.whatThisDoesNotEstablish: whose answer the join USED. These rules quantify over calls recorded in a window and every one of them is satisfied by a join that calls the repaired module correctly and returns the superseded module's answer: the repaired result is simply discarded. That is variant AX2, it is built and executed on every run, and this guard is measured silent for it. It is not whose answer was used, and it never was.

guardInventory.why: IR-EP11-NB-05: the predecessor's inventory claimed to list every guard the instrument runs and listed only the six the evasion matrix scored, omitting c2_api_surface entirely. This inventory lists EVERY mechanism in this file that can produce a finding, says for each whether the evasion matrix scores it, and publishes sole-guard status as a measured boolean only where it is measured and as null where it is not. An inventory that claims completeness and is not complete is the failure mode of IMPLEMENTATION-FREEZE 7 applied to the inventory itself.

RES-EP13-02. The answer-provenance property is NOT established against any route region that can distinguish a call this guard is measuring from a call it is not, BY ANY MEANS WHATEVER, and that answers honestly when it judges itself observed Every variant named in this document is an INSTANCE of that class and never its definition, and no set or count published here bounds it A-9 removes one means of distinguishing and is a NARROWING, NOT A CLOSURE THIS IS THE BOUNDARY and the banner is scoped by it. IR-EP12-01 rejected the predecessor for publishing an ENUMERATION of three variant names in this position: a reader told that only a frame read or a cell read breaks the green performs a cheap grep, excludes it, and draws a false conclusion. What is published now is the CAPABILITY that defeats the property. Reading this guard's frame or its servers' cells is one means; comparing the seat object against the one seen on the region's own first call is a second and needs no introspection at all; counting the ledger entries the region's own call produces is a third and compares no binding at all; there are others nobody here has thought of. The variants below are BUILT AND EXECUTED on every ordinary run and what they demonstrate is that the class is real, not that it is bounded. RES-EP13-16. A-2 and A-9 hold only inside a window this guard opens; outside such a window the answer is bound by VALUE and not by object identity, so a substitution outside it is DETECTED, NOT PREVENTED A region that behaves differently when observed is bounded here only by A-7's value agreement, by A-6's identity checks and by A-9's hidden window, and by nothing stronger On this corpus the two instruments agree everywhere except four positions, so a region that routes those four honestly satisfies every value rule there is This is the honest cost of the design and it is stated beside the rules rather than beneath them. A-9 narrows it: there is now a window the region cannot see, so a region that discriminates by reading bindings answers dishonestly inside a measured window and is reported. It does not remove it: a region that never reads a binding is bounded by value alone exactly as before, and MD5 is built to make that concrete rather than to leave it as a caveat. MEASURED ON THIS RUN: 21 of 21 unanchored answers.

knownLimitations.text: RES-EP13-18. A-9's hidden window is invisible to a region that reads bindings, and it is NOT invisible to a region that reads the ledger wrapper's own closure cell, nor to one that counts the ledger entries its own call produces The anchor's internal calls do not re-enter the shared ledger, and that difference is a side channel this instrument measures rather than denies: MD5 uses it and escapes The hidden window works by writing the contents of a closure cell that the ledger's own wrapper holds, which is a thing this guard can do and a region can observe if it looks there. It is also detectable without looking anywhere: an unobserved commitment call re-enters the ledger for its internal canonical call and an anchor-served one does not, so the entry delta says whether anyone is measuring. MD5 is that region, it is built and executed on every ordinary run, and it escapes every scored guard while routing every pinned commitment to the superseded encoder. Publishing the side channel beside the rule that has it is the only way a reader can price the rule. MEASURED ON THIS RUN: 3 observability variants caught by A-9, 1 measured escaping it.

knownLimitations.text: RES-EP13-19. Residual anchors are now LOAD-BEARING SENTENCES rather than short tokens, so a residual gutted to its anchors and padded to length is still the disclosure rather than a stub This does not stop an author writing the anchors and then padding them with contradictory prose, and no mechanical rule inside a checker can; binding is not meaning IR-EP12-NB-02 gutted six of the predecessor's residuals to their anchors plus their bound number plus padding, and the checker stayed green each time, because the anchors were short tokens like ROUTE REGION and AX6 that survive any amount of hollowing and mean nothing on their own. Here the anchors are the sentences that carry the disclosure and every residual's anchors must total at least 55% of its declared minimum length, which this checker measures about its own table and publishes. Gutting a residual to its anchors now leaves the disclosure standing. MEASURED ON THIS RUN: 5073 anchor characters across 19 residuals, 0 below 55% of their declared minimum.

knownLimitationsEnforcement.why: IR-EP12-NB-02: the predecessor's residual rule was a minimum length, an anchor grep over SHORT TOKENS, and a verbatim bound value, and its reviewer gutted six residuals to their anchors plus their bound number plus padding while the checker stayed green. Here the anchors ARE the disclosure: each is a load-bearing sentence, and every residual's anchors must total at least 55% of its declared minimum length, which the checker measures about its own table and publishes above. A residual gutted to its anchors is then still the residual. What this does NOT do is stop an author writing the anchors and padding them with contradictory prose, and RES-EP13-19 says so.
